Appliances

11

Air fryer

device.air_fryer

Device library → Appliances → Air fryer

How to use · 5 looks · Settings
radiant
convector
oven
boiler
element

How to access

  • Find it: Select Air fryer on the plan → Item inspector. To add one, choose Device library → Appliances → Air fryer, then click the plan. Press Esc to stop placing.

Air fryer is a device type.

Looks

A look is a different drawing rather than a restyling, and several bring their own footprint — choosing one on an item still at its default size resizes it to something true.

Find it: Select Air fryer on the plan → Item inspector → Look.

  • radiant
  • convector
  • oven
  • boiler
  • element

Settings

  • Facing (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5; default 0. Find it: Select Air fryer on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Facing (deg).
  • Rated load (W) (watt) — a number (1 to 20000); default 1500. Find it: Select Air fryer on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Rated load (W).
  • Marker size (px) (size) — a number (5 to 26), in steps of 0.5; default 8.5; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Air fryer on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Marker size (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.

Climate & air

19

Air conditioner

device.ac

Device library → Climate & air → Air conditioner

How to use · 5 looks · Settings
split
cassette
window
outdoor
portable

How to access

  • Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector. To add one, choose Device library → Climate & air → Air conditioner, then click the plan. Press Esc to stop placing.

Air conditioner is a device type. It can draw a air cone — what it reaches. It defaults off; the house or floor Coverage switch must also be enabled.

Looks

A look is a different drawing rather than a restyling, and several bring their own footprint — choosing one on an item still at its default size resizes it to something true.

Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector → Look.

  • split
  • cassette
  • window
  • outdoor
  • portable

Settings

  • Airflow direction (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5; default 270. Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Airflow direction (deg).
  • Coverage cone (cone) — Draw what this reaches. Off by default: on a real plan the wedges bury the rooms they are drawn on. Turning it on is what makes the field of view and range below matter. on or off; default false. Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Coverage cone.
  • Range (ft) (range) — a number (1 to 120), in steps of 0.5; default 9. Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Range (ft). Enable Coverage cone in Aim and coverage to reveal this setting.
  • Capacity (tons) (tons) — a number (0.5 to 10), in steps of 0.25; default 1.5; measured in TR; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Capacity (tons). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Marker size (px) (size) — a number (5 to 26), in steps of 0.5; default 8.5; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Air conditioner on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Marker size (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.

Looks

A look is a different drawing rather than a restyling, and several bring their own footprint — choosing one on an item still at its default size resizes it to something true.

  • dumbwaiter — 2 × 2 ft

Settings

  • Width (ft) (w) — a number (0.25 to 200), in steps of 0.25; default 3.5. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Size → Width (ft).
  • Depth (ft) (h) — a number (0.25 to 200), in steps of 0.25; default 10. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Size → Depth (ft).
  • Rotation (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Rotation (deg).
  • Steps (steps) — a number (2 to 40), in steps of 1; default 9. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Steps.
  • Run axis (axis) — one of ns, ew; default ns. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Run axis.
  • Direction (dir) — one of up, down; default up. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Direction.
  • At the floor line (continues) — A stair on a plan is a stair cut about four feet above this floor: what is past that point belongs to the storey above and is drawn faint beyond a break line. Which way this flight travels is set by Direction, above. one of none, cut, both; default cut. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → At the floor line.
  • Where the cut falls (0–1) (cutAt) — How far along the flight the floor plane crosses it — later for a shallow run of deep treads, earlier for a steep one. a number (0.15 to 0.9), in steps of 0.05; default 0.6; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Where the cut falls (0–1). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Step lighting (lighting) — one of none, edge, side, both; default none. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Step lighting.
  • Lit every N steps (lightEvery) — a number (1 to 8), in steps of 1; default 1. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Lit every N steps.
  • When lit (sequence) — one of together, progressive; default together. Find it: Select Stairs on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → When lit.

Flood light

fixture.flood

Device library → Lighting → Flood light

How to use · Settings

How to access

  • Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector. To add one, choose Device library → Lighting → Flood light, then click the plan. Press Esc to stop placing.

Flood light is a fixture type. It can draw a vision cone — what it reaches. It defaults off; the house or floor Coverage switch must also be enabled.

Settings

  • Watts (each lamp) (watt) — a number (1 to 2000); default 30. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Light output → Watts (each lamp).
  • Lamps on this marker (count) — a number (1 to 64), in steps of 1; default 1. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Light output → Lamps on this marker.
  • Efficacy (lm/W) (efficacy) — a number (5 to 220), in steps of 1; default 100. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Light output → Efficacy (lm/W).
  • Beam spread (ft) (beam) — a number (0.2 to 40), in steps of 0.1; default 6.5. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Light output → Beam spread (ft).
  • Colour when unreported (K) (kelvin) — a number (1800 to 7000), in steps of 50; default 5000. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Light output → Colour when unreported (K).
  • Coverage cone (cone) — Draw what this reaches. Off by default: on a real plan the wedges bury the rooms they are drawn on. Turning it on is what makes the field of view and range below matter. on or off; default false. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Coverage cone.
  • Beam angle (deg) (fov) — a number (5 to 360), in steps of 5; default 100. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Beam angle (deg). Enable Coverage cone in Aim and coverage to reveal this setting.
  • Throw (ft) (range) — a number (1 to 120), in steps of 0.5; default 16. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Throw (ft). Enable Coverage cone in Aim and coverage to reveal this setting.
  • Facing (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5; default 0. Find it: Select Flood light on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Facing (deg).

  • Detection cone (cone) — Draw what this reaches. Off by default: on a real plan the wedges bury the rooms they are drawn on. Turning it on is what makes the field of view and range below matter. on or off; default false. Find it: Select Camera on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Detection cone.
  • Field of view (deg) (fov) — a number (5 to 360), in steps of 5; default 90. Find it: Select Camera on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Field of view (deg). Enable Detection cone in Aim and coverage to reveal this setting.

  • Mounted on (mount) — Where it is fixed. Shown when you hover the marker on the dashboard; it does not change the drawing. one of wall, ceiling, corner, pole, doorbell; default wall; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Camera on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Mounted on. Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Marker size (px) (size) — a number (5 to 26), in steps of 0.5; default 8.5; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Camera on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Marker size (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.

Settings

  • Text template (template) — Safe tokens: {{ value }}, {{ unit }}, {{ name }}, {{ entity }}, and {{ attr.attribute_name }}. Example: {{ value }} °C. text; default {{ value }}. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Text template.
  • Text color (color) — color; default @wallThick. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Text color.
  • Background color (backgroundColor) — color; default transparent. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Background color.
  • Text size (px) (fontSize) — a number (6 to 48), in steps of 1; default 12. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Text size (px).
  • Text weight (fontWeight) — a number (100 to 900), in steps of 100; default 600; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Text weight. Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Facing (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5; default 0. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Facing (deg).
  • Horizontal padding (px) (paddingX) — a number (0 to 40), in steps of 1; default 7; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Horizontal padding (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Vertical padding (px) (paddingY) — a number (0 to 24), in steps of 1; default 4; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Vertical padding (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Border color (borderColor) — color; default @offRim; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Border color. Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Border width (px) (borderWidth) — a number (0 to 8), in steps of 0.5; default 1; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Border width (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Border style (borderStyle) — one of solid, dashed, none; default solid; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Border style. Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Corner radius (px) (borderRadius) — a number (0 to 30), in steps of 1; default 4; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Corner radius (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Threshold color applies to (thresholdTarget) — one of text, border, both; default text; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Threshold color applies to. Enable Advanced in the top bar.
  • Value thresholds (thresholds) — The color for the highest threshold less than or equal to the numeric entity value is used. thresholds. Find it: Select Entity value label on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Value thresholds.

Looks

A look is a different drawing rather than a restyling, and several bring their own footprint — choosing one on an item still at its default size resizes it to something true.

Find it: Select Motion / presence on the plan → Item inspector → Look.

  • dome
  • wall
  • radar
  • vibration

Settings

  • Facing (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5; default 0. Find it: Select Motion / presence on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Facing (deg).
  • Detection cone (cone) — Draw what this reaches. Off by default: on a real plan the wedges bury the rooms they are drawn on. Turning it on is what makes the field of view and range below matter. on or off; default false. Find it: Select Motion / presence on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Detection cone.
  • Field of view (deg) (fov) — a number (5 to 360), in steps of 5; default 110. Find it: Select Motion / presence on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Field of view (deg). Enable Detection cone in Aim and coverage to reveal this setting.
  • Range (ft) (range) — a number (1 to 120), in steps of 0.5; default 16. Find it: Select Motion / presence on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Range (ft). Enable Detection cone in Aim and coverage to reveal this setting.
  • Marker size (px) (size) — a number (5 to 26), in steps of 0.5; default 8.5; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Motion / presence on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Marker size (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.

How to access

  • Find it: Select Weather station on the plan → Item inspector. To add one, choose Device library → Sensors & security → Weather station, then click the plan. Press Esc to stop placing.

Weather station is a device type.

Looks

A look is a different drawing rather than a restyling, and several bring their own footprint — choosing one on an item still at its default size resizes it to something true.

Find it: Select Weather station on the plan → Item inspector → Look.

  • drop
  • tank
  • tap
  • pump
  • meter

Settings

  • Facing (deg) (rot) — a number (0 to 359), in steps of 5; default 0. Find it: Select Weather station on the plan → Item inspector → Aim and coverage → Facing (deg).
  • Marker size (px) (size) — a number (5 to 26), in steps of 0.5; default 8.5; shown under Advanced. Find it: Select Weather station on the plan → Item inspector → Properties → Marker size (px). Enable Advanced in the top bar.
